title: Training Note: Card Payments Counted Against the Credit-Card Ceiling (Placed Consumer Accounts)
content:
Training note for collectors on **Placed Consumer Accounts**: which card payments are counted against the credit-card ceiling of the day.

## The rule

The card payments counted against the credit-card ceiling are:
- **every card payment, debit or credit, received in the last two months**, where one or more returned payments were received on the account in the last six months and one or more card payments were received in the last month;
- **every card payment, debit or credit, received in the last month**, where no returned payment was received on the account in the last six months and one or more card payments were received in the last month;
- **the credit-card payments received in the last month**, in every other case.

Each card payment counted counts at its posted amount, and the total counted is subtracted in working out the credit-card ceiling.

## Questions and answers

**What is "the last month", "the last two months", "the last six months"?** A payment or return falls in the last N months when fewer than N whole calendar months separate its date from the handling date, a whole month being reached on the same day of a later month. On a handling date of 2026-10-10 the last month starts on 2026-09-11, the last two months on 2026-08-11 and the last six months on 2026-04-11.

**Which returns count for the six-month test?** Any returned-payment entry on the account's money history, whatever its channel, by the date the return was received.

**Does a card payment dated the handling date itself fall in the last month?** Yes. It is zero whole months old.

**What if no card payment at all was received in the last month?** Then the third line applies: the credit-card payments received in the last month, which in that case total nothing.

## Decision table

| Returned payment in the last six months | Card payment (debit or credit) in the last month | Card payments counted |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Debit-card and credit-card payments of the last two months |
| No | Yes | Debit-card and credit-card payments of the last month |
| Yes | No | Credit-card payments of the last month |
| No | No | Credit-card payments of the last month |

## Hypothetical case

*Invented history, handling date 2026-10-10.* Debit-card payment $600.00 on 2026-08-20; credit-card payment $250.00 on 2026-09-28; a bank-debit payment returned on 2026-06-02.
- A return falls in the last six months and a card payment falls in the last month, so the last two months count: $600.00 plus $250.00 gives $850.00.
- Without the 2026-06-02 return, only the last month would count: $250.00.
